site.title: Hyeon Jun Lim
site.description: Senior Research Engineer at Hyundai Motor Company. Reinforcement learning, end-to-end planning, and LiDAR perception for autonomous driving.

profile.name: Hyeon Jun Lim
profile.affiliation: Autonomous Driving Development, Hyundai Motor Company
bio: I build a closed-loop reinforcement learning framework for autonomous driving, as a Senior Research Engineer at Hyundai Motor Company.

I have also developed an end-to-end autonomous driving system and ran it on a real vehicle, built a LiDAR perception system for Lv.3 and Lv.4 autonomous driving, and constructed Korea's first large-scale LiDAR dataset.

My goal is to make reinforcement learning work on physical systems beyond driving. Simulation and logged experience each fall short on their own, so I work on sim-to-real transfer alongside offline learning from the data that deployed systems already produce, and on judging how far a policy trained either way can be trusted before it reaches hardware.

projects.title: Unified Closed-Loop Simulation Framework for RL-Based Autonomous Driving
projects.summary: Built a closed-loop RL training stack combining 3DGS photorealistic environments, rule-driven reward modeling, and World-Model synthetic data, then deployed the resulting driving policies on physical vehicles.

projects.title: End-to-End Autonomous Planning System
projects.summary: Led development, embedded deployment, and real-world validation of a Transformer-based end-to-end planner, including its first-ever on-vehicle control.

projects.title: Lv.3 / Lv.4 Autonomous Driving Perception Systems (HDP & Robo-Services)
projects.summary: Led the company's LiDAR perception stack, covering sensor evaluation, clustering, localization, and online calibration, validated on Lv.3 and Lv.4 platforms.

projects.title: River Management Technology Using a Drone-Based Survey Platform
projects.summary: Built a high-fidelity LiDAR simulation framework to derive hardware specifications and validate dual-wavelength bathymetric sensing for river and subsurface mapping.

projects.title: 3D Vehicle Shape Generation System for Automated Car Wash
projects.summary: Developed a sub-2 cm-accuracy multi-LiDAR vehicle-profiling system for unmanned car-wash automation, running in real time on TI embedded hardware.

projects.title: Standardized Open Database and Evaluation System for Intelligent Vehicle Perception
projects.summary: Built South Korea's first large-scale 128-channel LiDAR dataset for autonomous driving, with over a million labeled objects, automated annotation, and cm-level HD mapping.

projects.title: Vision-IMU Integrated Indoor Navigation System for the Visually Impaired
projects.summary: Fused CCTV-based machine learning positioning with smartphone IMU dead-reckoning to keep tracking users through camera blind spots, and built the guidance pipeline around it with a control server, a mobile app, and A*-based safety-aware routing.
